segs.text: What is the oldest music we can prove?

In caves of the Swabian Jura, in southern Germany, archaeologists found flutes. The best preserved came from Hohle Fels, in summer two thousand eight. It was made from the wing bone of a griffon vulture. Twenty one point eight centimeters survive, with five finger holes and two V shaped notches at one end. It was found in twelve pieces.

How old is it? The Nature paper said older than thirty five thousand calendar years. Nearby, at Geissenklösterle cave, there are flutes of swan bone and mammoth ivory. Animal bones in the same layers date to about forty two to forty three thousand years ago. Note that: the layers were dated, not the flutes themselves.
An ivory flute is hard to make. The maker split a curved piece of tusk in two, hollowed both halves, carved the holes, and joined the halves airtight. So these were made with skill, and with a plan.

Now the disputed one. In Slovenia, in nineteen ninety five, a cave bear thighbone with holes was found at Divje Babe. It is estimated at fifty to sixty thousand years old, from Neanderthal times. Its discoverers say Neanderthals made it. Other scientists say hyenas or other animals chewed those holes. This is not settled.

What did it sound like? We do not know. The Hohle Fels flute has a broken end, so some length is missing. Modern replicas can play several notes. But that shows what the tube can do, not what anyone played. No tune survives, and no rhythm. Complete flutes that we can test are younger: bird bone flutes from Jiahu in China, with five to eight holes, from about seven thousand B C.

Writing appears about five thousand three hundred years ago. These flutes are at least thirty thousand years older. Why did people make music first? That is open. A twenty nineteen study of three hundred fifteen societies found song in every one, tied to lullabies, dance, healing and love. That shows what music does today. It does not show why it began. And voices leave no bones. Singing may be far older.
So the oldest music we can prove is a vulture bone flute. The oldest music is unknown.
